text.en:
Section 1 of Presidential Decree No. 107, as amended, is hereby further amended to read as
"Sec. 1. There is hereby created a National Economic and Development Authority to be composed of the
President of the Philippines, as Chairman, and the Secretary of Economic Planning (Director-General of the
Authority) the Secretary of Finance, the Secretary of Foreign Affairs, the Secretary of Agriculture, the
Secretary of Trade, the Secretary of Public Works, Transportation and Communications, the Secretary of
National Defense, the Secretary of Labor, the Secretary of Education and Culture, the Secretary of Industry,
the Secretary of Natural Resources, the Secretary of Public Highways, the Commissioner of the Budget and
the Governor of the Central Bank, as members, and who shall hold office at the pleasure of the President.
The Authority may, in the discharge of its duties and functions, call upon any private person or representative
of the private sector for such view or advice as may be pertinent to any matter under its consideration."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 23rd day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
